set.body: Extract modules/multivar and modules/multivar-ir into a general JVM/Scala.js library at canardlapin/multivar; remove ScalaFIM-only dependencies, preserve provenance and oracle fixtures, publish a verified standalone tip, then migrate ScalaFIM consumers to a pinned source dependency without disturbing unrelated in-flight work. Completion requires standalone and host JVM+JS gates.
set.title: Extract multivar into standalone canardlapin package
